wesenCore: Humans see your Wesen face only when you choose a full woge.
You see other Wesen when they woge, and you see a Grimm's eyes.
A free action, in or out. Anger, frustration or fright can force one: when an enemy appears, you're frightened or you're attacked, the GM can call for a Will roll; on a failure you woge.
Ordinary people panic or attack; Persuasion with them is impossible. A full woge seen by townsfolk marks Exposure (2 boxes for a Tier 3 heritage).
−2 to Riding while woged; a horse won't carry a woged rider.
Your secret is deadly. Wesen who expose themselves answer to the Council, and to Grimms.

heritages.name: Human
heritages.desc: Most people are human. You know the truth about the hidden world, which already sets you apart.
traits: +2 to Will against fear when facing something that shouldn't exist.
When you tell ordinary folk what you've seen, accept being called mad, drunk or a liar.
+2 to Read People when judging, face to face, whether someone is lying.
You act on an unproven feeling. Accept the consequence when it costs time, trust or position.

heritages.name: Fuchsbau
heritages.desc: Fox-like Wesen, clever and quick, with a long tradition of trade in herbs, remedies and harder-to-find ingredients. Other Wesen call them disreputable, and not always unfairly.

traits: Keen senses: track by scent and hearing
+2 to Apothecary when brewing a remedy, antidote or potion from the old recipes.
Your family deals in the Wesen black market. Accept their demands or their trouble.
+2 to Deception when misleading a pursuer or covering your tracks.
You overplay your hand. Accept the consequence when the trick backfires.
+2 to Shooting with a bow from the saddle.
Wesen assume a Fuchsbau is up to something. Accept the distrust when it costs you.

heritages.name: Coyotl
heritages.desc: Coyote-like Wesen of the plains and desert country who live in clans bound by old customs, and fight together like a pack.

traits: Keen senses: track by scent and hearing
Swift: Move +1, and +2 to Athletics when running
+2 to Brawling or Melee against a target an ally attacked this round.
The clan's customs bind you. Accept the clan's demand.
+2 to Survival in dry, open country: plains, desert and badlands.
You can't stay put for long. Accept leaving, or the strain of staying, at a bad time.

heritages.name: Eisbiber
heritages.desc: Beaver-like Wesen: builders, neighbors and gossips, close-knit and peaceable, and easily frightened by violence. Bullies like the Hässlich prey on them.

traits: Teeth gnaw through wood and rope (a bite marks 1 box)
Swimmer: holds breath for minutes; +2 to Athletics when swimming
+2 to Tinkering when building or shoring up structures, dams or mechanisms.
Violence makes you freeze. Accept losing your first action when a fight breaks out.
+2 to Investigation when asking the local Wesen community for news.
The lodge expects favors. Accept the call when it comes at a bad time.

heritages.name: Bauerschwein
heritages.desc: Pig-like Wesen: stubborn, hard-working, with senses sharp even in human form, and old enemies of the Blutbaden. Their feud is settled, when it must be, by the Ehrenkampf, a ritual duel.
core: Sharp senses even unwoged: you can identify people and things by smell in either form.
traits: +2 to Will to resist intimidation, especially from a Blutbad.
Blutbaden are your people's enemies. When one is near, accept the quarrel, or the challenge to Ehrenkampf.
+2 to Intellect rolls to notice or identify something by smell.
Your honesty offends someone who matters. Accept the lost goodwill.

heritages.name: Mauzhertz
heritages.desc: Mouse-like Wesen, small, quick and wary, with excellent hearing. Gentle by nature, but one pushed too far can snap.

traits: Keen hearing: hear whispers through walls
+2 to Stealth when hiding or slipping away.
Sudden noise or danger makes you flinch. Accept −2 on your next action.
+2 to Intellect rolls to hear faint or distant sounds.
Pushed too far, you snap into violence. Accept what you do in that moment.

heritages.name: Ziegevolk
heritages.desc: Goat-like Wesen whose pheromones, working even in human form, make them unnaturally persuasive and unnaturally popular. A Fuchsbau remedy can protect against them.
traits: +2 to Persuasion face to face at close quarters, in either form. Grimms and anyone dosed with the antidote are unaffected.
Those who know what you are wonder whether they were persuaded or drugged. Accept the distrust.
+2 to Deception when talking your way past a guard or official.
Affairs and broken hearts trail behind you. Accept the jealous husband or the angry ex.

heritages.name: Steinadler
heritages.desc: Eagle-like Wesen with remarkable eyesight, a hunter's pride, and a taste for working alone, sometimes for hire.

traits: Eagle sight: see detail a mile away
+2 to Intellect rolls to spot detail at a great distance.
You won't back down or beg. Accept the consequence of your pride.
+2 to Shooting at long range after aiming for an action.
You won't shoot an unarmed or fleeing foe. Accept the escape.

heritages.name: Taniwha
heritages.desc: Water-dwelling Wesen from New Zealand: guardians of rivers and the people they claim, reptile-like in woge, and dangerous to anyone else. Horror campaigns only.
core: Resists poison: +4 to Body against any poison.
Hunger (horror): each season you must eat human flesh; until you do, mark a box that rest can't clear, every three days.

traits: Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
Amphibious: breathes water, swims as fast as a horse runs
drawbacks: Must be submerged in water daily, or mark a box that rest can't clear, each hour
Pounamu (greenstone) wounds mark one extra box

traits: Ability, in full woge: a bite marks 1 box, and the target rolls Body or is paralyzed for the scene.
You protect those you've claimed as yours. Accept the danger when they need you.
+2 to Athletics and Survival in rivers, lakes and the sea.
Gluttony, and an odd craving (frogs, to start with). Accept the distraction at a bad time.

heritages.name: Blutbad
heritages.desc: Wolf-like Wesen with keen senses and a predator's appetite; the root of the werewolf legend. Wesen who know your kind assume you hunt humans. You don't, or not anymore.
core: Reputation: Eats Humans. Wesen who know your kind assume the worst.

traits: Keen senses: track by scent and hearing
+2 to Tracking by scent, in either form.
When blood is spilled near you or something runs, roll Will or woge and give chase. Accept the cost of the urge.
+2 to Stealth when stalking at night.
You shun company. Accept the cost of going it alone.
Bauerschwein are your enemies. When one is near, accept the quarrel.

heritages.name: Mauvais Dentes
heritages.desc: Sabre-toothed, panther-like Wesen, so deadly that the Royal Families have kept them as assassins. Rare, solitary, and feared even by other Wesen.
core: Reputation: Eats Humans. Wesen who know your kind assume the worst.

traits: Sabre teeth and claws mark 2 boxes
Keen senses: track by scent and hearing
+2 to Tracking when hunting a single named quarry.
The Royals bred your line as killers. When one of their agents calls on you, accept the demand or the danger of refusing.
+2 to Brawling on your first attack of a fight, leaping from hiding.
In a fight you go for the throat. Accept the death you didn't intend.

heritages.name: Skalengeck
heritages.desc: Lizard-like Wesen, cold-eyed and hard to kill, with a poisonous bite. Common among outlaws and hired guns.

traits: Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
Ability, in full woge: a bite that marks a box also poisons. Each hour the victim rolls Body −3 or marks another box, until treated with Apothecary.
You don't much care who gets hurt. Accept the cost when that shows.
+2 to Body to resist being knocked out, stunned or restrained.
When you're trapped, you woge and fight. Accept the Exposure and the damage.

heritages.name: Jägerbär
heritages.desc: Bear-like Wesen, enormously strong and durable. Traditional families still keep the Roh-Hatz, a coming-of-age hunt, and fight with an old Germanic weapon whose claw-like scoop disembowels.

traits: Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
+2 to Athletics for feats of raw strength: lifting, breaking, holding.
Your family keeps the old hunting rite. Accept the obligation, or the shame of refusing it.
+2 to Melee with your family's claw-bladed hunting weapon.
Once angered, you're hard to stop. Accept the harm you do to something you shouldn't.

heritages.name: Naschazer
heritages.desc: Brutish, ogre-like Wesen of enormous strength who crave human flesh. Horror campaigns only.
core: Hunger (horror): each month you must eat human flesh; until you do, mark a box that rest can't clear, every day.

traits: Huge strength: fists and fangs mark 2 boxes
Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
Feels no pain: ignore the Wounded penalty
Heals fast: each day of rest clears a box, however hurt you are
+2 to Athletics to lift, break or hold.
Riches are hard to refuse. Accept the bribe's strings or the risk of taking more.
+2 to Melee with a cleaver, axe or knife.
You won't be slighted. Accept the fight your pride starts.

heritages.name: Vallachi
heritages.desc: Long-lived, handsome, vampire-like Wesen who feed on the lifeforce of others and shun the sun. Horror campaigns only.
core: Lifedrain (horror): by touch, roll Will against the victim's Body; on a success they mark a box and you clear one.
Hunger (horror): each week you must drain lifeforce; until you do, mark a box that rest can't clear, every six hours.
Sunlight: −2 to all rolls in direct sun, and you tire quickly.
Lifebane: plants wilt and animals shy around you.

traits: Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer, except from a pointed wooden stake
+2 to Persuasion face to face, after dark.
You've lived long enough to make enemies. Accept it when one of them turns up.
+2 to Intellect rolls to recall something you lived through decades ago.
You don't age as you should. Accept the lie or the slip when someone notices.

heritages.name: Grimm
heritages.desc: A descendant of the old hunters, the Decapitare: stronger and faster than ordinary people, able to see the Wesen hidden among us, and feared by them.
core: The Sight: you see a Wesen's face when it's stirred by strong emotion.
Grimm eyes: woged Wesen and other Grimms see them; humans don't.
Uneasy sense: you feel when a Wesen or magic is near, with no details.
Never freeze: you're never surprised, and +2 to Will against fear.
Hard to bewitch: +2 to Will against magic.
Raised on the books: Wesen Lore is always at least Trained, free.
Grimm blood: a Hexenbiest or Zauberbiest who drinks it under a full moon loses their powers (see Grimm blood).
traits: Ability: when an ambush or trap threatens you, the GM secretly rolls your Intellect; success warns you in time to act.
The dead you've seen come back at night. Accept the lost sleep at a bad time.
Ability: each hit that marks 2 or more boxes marks one fewer (never below 1).
Wesen must die. Accept the trouble when mercy would be wiser.
Ability: each day of rest clears a box, however hurt you are, and rest works at three boxes even with nobody tending you.
You won't rest when there's a case. Accept the strain.
+2 to Body to resist poison, disease and exhaustion.
You won't back down. Accept the cost.
+2 to Shooting with a pistol at close range, with no need to aim.
+2 to Athletics and Melee to keep your feet or fight on bad ground.
Accept the risk your curiosity brings.
Ability: your Brawling hits mark 2 boxes.
You don't stop at the surrender. Accept the consequences.
+2 to Melee or Shooting with one named heirloom weapon.
When it's lost or taken, accept the risk to get it back.
Ability: Dying lasts until the end of the next scene, not this one.
You've sworn to protect the innocent from Wesen. Accept the danger.
You won't lie, even to Wesen. Accept the consequence.
+2 to Wesen Lore when you can consult your family's books.
The books are irreplaceable and coveted. When they are threatened, accept the risk of protecting them.

heritages.name: Incantare
heritages.desc: A human who works real magic through a Lens: a tradition and a way of seeing. The Wesen Council, the Royals and the Order of the Holy Knife all watch for people like you.
core: Rituals: roll Occult to fill a ritual clock (minor 2, significant 4, major 6 segments). Your Lens sets how.
Charms: you can carry as many ready charms as your Occult training allows (Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4).
Grimms sense your magic: +1 to notice it for each charm or potion you carry.
traits: Brews elixirs, potions and powders ahead of time: hours to make, an instant to use. +2 to Occult when brewing. Only a Chymiater can brew the Grimm-blood draught.
Your craft feeds a vice: greed, drink, lechery or gluttony (agree which). Accept it when it bites.
Glamours, illusions and mesmerism worked through performance, music or art, in minutes. +2 to Occult for illusion and mesmerism.
You need an audience and can't bear an insult to your art. Accept the trouble your vanity causes.
Scholarly ritual from grimoires, the Sixth and Seventh Books of Moses among them: any kind of effect, but an hour per roll, and it needs books. +2 to Occult for divination and wards.
A grimoire, a ritual or a secret tempts you beyond sense. Accept the risk to get it.
Hexerei: curses and hexes, and the breaking of them, worked through a link: blood, hair or a treasured object; −4 without one. +2 to Occult for curses with a link.
People whisper that you're a hexer, and the Order of the Holy Knife listens. Accept the suspicion.
Rites of the seasons, nature and the old gods, worked outdoors; in America, often behind the doors of a Druid lodge. +2 to Occult for nature and folk magic.
The old observances bind you: festivals, offerings, taboos. Accept the delay or cost of keeping them.
Braucherei, the Pennsylvania Dutch healing craft: spoken charms, prayers and blessed objects, from The Long Lost Friend. +2 to Occult to heal, protect, or break a hex.
A Braucher takes no money for healing, only gifts. Accept the cost when the need is great and the purse is empty.
Enchants objects and works of art; the best charm-maker. +2 to Occult when making charms or enchanting an object, and you can carry one extra charm.
Moods, jealousy and obsession with your work. Accept the cost when your temper or a rival gets to you.
Casts spells: quick magic in one action and an Occult roll, shaped by one or two Paths agreed with the GM (fire and force, say). Known: Trained 2, Specialty 3, Expert 4. You can carry only one charm.
Your power follows one narrow calling. Accept the cost of serving it when it clashes with your friends' needs.

heritages.name: Hexenbiest or Zauberbiest
heritages.desc: Witch-like Wesen (Zauberbiest for the men), beautiful in human form and horrific in woge, with innate magic that lives in their Wesen spirit. Coven traditions bind them; Grimm blood can strip them.
core: Telekinesis: in full or partial woge, roll Will to throw a person or object with your mind (1 box), seize something out of reach, or turn aside one attack (+2 Dodge).
Innate magic: you can work rituals with Occult like an Incantare, in the Hexenbiest style: curses, potions and sendings.
Grimm blood: drunk under a full moon, it strips your powers until the Contaminatio Ritualis restores them.

traits: Tough: hits of 2+ boxes mark one fewer
+2 to Occult for curses, potions and sendings.
Every spell costs blood, pain or something precious. Accept the cost when it bites.
Ability, in woge: roll Will to lift yourself and float or fly a short way.
You cannot abide being bested or slighted. Accept the feud you start.
Ability, in full woge: roll Will against the target's Body; on a success they mark 1 box, which Dodge can't avoid.
Your family or coven has rules and expectations. Accept the demand.

heritages.name: Murcielago
heritages.desc: Bat-like Wesen with uncanny hearing and a sonic scream that drops a room full of people to their knees.
core: Sonic scream: in full woge, roll Will. Everyone nearby you choose who can hear rolls Body −2; a failure loses their next action and takes −2 for the scene. Earplugs protect. Heard in town, it marks Exposure.

traits: Sonar: no penalty for darkness; sense the shape of a room by sound
+2 to Intellect rolls to find something hidden in the dark by sound.
Loud noise disorients you. When a gun or explosion goes off nearby, accept −2 on your next action.
+2 to Intellect rolls to hear faint or distant voices.
You hear secrets you shouldn't. Accept the trouble that knowing brings.

heritages.name: Fuchsteufelwild
heritages.desc: Goblin-like Wesen, green-skinned in woge with fingers fused into acid talons; the root of Rumpelstiltskin. Clever, spiteful, and bound by an old obsession with names and bargains.
core: Acid talons: in full woge, claw hits mark 2 boxes and ignore Tough and armor.
Leaper, in either form: jumps of many yards; +2 to Athletics to jump.

traits: Keen senses: track by scent and hearing
drawbacks: Fused claws: −2 to Tinkering, Shooting and other fine handwork while woged

traits: Ability, in full woge: stomp, and everyone nearby rolls Athletics or falls and loses their next action.
When an enemy is helpless, you're tempted to make them suffer. Accept the lost allies, or the Suspicion it brings.
+2 to Persuasion or Deception when making a deal.
Your true name holds power over you. When someone hunts for it, or speaks it, accept the consequence.
